stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: Kyle Tucker is now projected to beat Kirbo Crushers.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Mr. Action Jackson vs Gibb it to Me Baby. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Mr. Action Jackson 84% / 53%, Gibb it to Me Baby 80% / 51%.
😬 Claremont In Yo Stace! would be leading Ruffing the Passer if they'd started Cam Skattebo over Devin Singletary — instead they trail by 13.90 pts.
🧟 LINEUP ALERT: Ruffing the Passer is starting Carnell Tate (OUT). Kickoff's Sunday 1 PM — plenty of time to fix it. Or don't. We'll be watching.
🎯 Kyle Tucker has moved into the median race — 45% to finish above it.
⚡ Early edge: Gibb it to Me Baby went from 63% to 89% against Mr. Action Jackson, led by Likely (28.70 pts).
🎲 GUTSY CALL: Claremont In Yo Stace! started Singletary (NYG's RB2) over Skattebo. It backfired: Skattebo outscored Singletary by 26.90.
🎯 TWO WINS: Gibb it to Me Baby: 80% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 39% with none (now 77%).
🪑 Claremont In Yo Stace! has left 26.90 pts on the bench this week. Starting Cam Skattebo (27.20 pts) over Devin Singletary (0.30 pts) alone was worth 26.90 pts.
🔢 MAGIC NUMBER: Brock You Like a Hurricane clinches a playoff spot with 3 more wins, no matter what anyone else does.
📰 Patriots place RB TreVeyon Henderson on IR with still unexplained illness. That's Kyle Tucker's RB. Phones are buzzing.
⚔️ Kyle Tucker vs Kirbo Crushers is projected to finish just 0.56 pts apart.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 13% against Mr. Action Jackson — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted Mr. Action Jackson after the favorite flipped 8 times.
